_warning: GM ONLY. The narrator receives one fragment's content at a time and never learns what it connects to.

fragments.trigger: seeing military insignia, uniforms, or ordered rows of equipment
fragments.content: Hands on a rifle that is not this rifle. Someone laughing to your left. The taste of dust and the smell of hot oil.

fragments.trigger: antiseptic, bleach, or any clean chemical smell indoors
fragments.content: A white room. A table with a channel cut down the middle of it. A voice, very calm: hold still.

fragments.trigger: church bells, or hearing Miranda's name spoken in reverence
fragments.content: Kneeling. Not praying — the floor is cold and your knees hurt and you are being made to wait.
fragments.note: deliberate dead end; not every thread goes somewhere
